label: Family overview to nursing/leisure facilities
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport family-route overview into the L6 nursing room, stroller, and leisure-facility frame. The camera should travel from the overview into the family service cluster as if the airport map is one continuous canvas, keeping the blue route, soft glass architecture, and service icons stable. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not over-emphasize duty-free shopping or add shop names. Do not invent gate numbers, flight times, lounge names, or dense signage. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
